summary: Soviet agronomist Trofim Lysenko rejected genetics, faked his results and, backed by Stalin, purged rival scientists; his pseudoscience drove farm policy in the USSR and Mao's China, worsening famines that killed millions.

evidence.note: long opening segment on Ivanov's ape-human hybrid scheme, including his stint in French Guinea
Vavilov's life, seed-collecting travels and institute network get their own segment
Lysenko's peasant birth in what is now Ukraine and his entry into agricultural science
faked vernalization results and the Pravda profile that made him famous
collectivization, the Soviet famine and the Holodomor as deliberate starvation
Vavilov arrested in 1940 and dies in a gulag in 1943; mass purge of geneticists
second part moves to Mao's China and its adoption of Lysenko's methods
staged fields and inflated harvest reports put on for Mao
Great Famine to 1961 with a death toll of 25 to 35 million
1964 Sakharov denunciation and 1965 removal and investigation end his career
death in Moscow in 1976, then a segment on his revival in present-day Russia

notes: main_span starts at the 1927 Pravda profile (year from general knowledge; the transcript garbles it) and ends with his 1965 fall. Setting puts RU first because the Soviet famine and the purges happen there, with CN (part two) close behind. Lysenko held real agronomy training, so scientist-scholar rather than quack-fake-healer; politician-official covers his Lenin Academy presidency and state posts.
